ns2:course.label: The School Superintendency
ns2:course.description: Course examines the legal and fiscal responsibilities of school superintendents, the relationship of superintendents with school boards and employee groups, the importance of public relations and partnerships with community stakeholders, the process for selecting superintendents, and the effect of the position on individuals. Prerequisite: Students must be admitted to the EOL Superintendent Endorsement program or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Students must be admitted to the EOL Superintendent Endorsement program or consent of instructor.
